On her feet, she would wear sleek, ankle-high boots with a moderate heel, made of soft leather and featuring intricate, geometric patterns.

A pair of silver hoop earrings, a simple silver chain necklace, and a matching bracelet would be among her favorites. She might also wear a ring on her right hand, featuring a small, precious stone in a muted color.

Overall, the fusion of Asuka Kazama and Lili Rochefort would result in a young woman who exudes confidence, grace, and strength. Her unique appearance would reflect her diverse background and her exceptional abilities, making her a truly unforgettable character.
